dataList.title: Head to B1F
dataList.description: Apparently, we're still lacking in "virtue" to enter 5F. Пви said they need to wear a Golden Shroud, и that somewhere down on the underground floors, there's someone who can process hides. Let's head there.

dataList.title: Find the Ruminations of the Prey
dataList.description: To obtain the Golden Cocoon, we need to bring the Ruminations of the Prey to Boucher, B1F's Floor Manager. It should be somewhere nearby. Let's find it quickly.

steps.goalDescription1: Find the Ruminations of the Prey

dataList.title: Subdue Sous Chef
dataList.description:
We returned to the Food Court with the Ruminations of the Prey. After sniffing Пви a few раз, Sous Chef suddenly began attacking us...

First, let's subdue Sous Chef.

dataList.title: Talk to B1F's Floor Manager
dataList.description:
Sous Chef suddenly attacked us after sniffing Пви a few раз, but calmed down один раз she heard that we'd brought Ruminations of the Prey with us, и agreed to introduce us to Boucher, the Floor Manager при B1F.

Let's talk to Boucher.

steps.goalDescription1: Give the Ruminations of the Prey to B1F's Floor Manager

dataList.title: Head to the Shore
dataList.description: The Sous Chef, panicking, told us that the larva kept in the storage had escaped. It should be on the Shore just beyond the Fish Market. With no other options, we decided to head there и look for a living larva.

dataList.title: Investigate the Squirming Larva
dataList.description: We've reached the Shore, where countless larvae are drifting toward the sea. One of them is still moving. We should approach it.

dataList.title: Return to Sous Chef
dataList.description: We found one that's still breathing. Получает it back to the Food Court и hand it over to the Sous Chef.

dataList.title: To the Escalator Hall
dataList.description: Just like last time, we've got ourselves a Golden Cocoon... или rather, "Wriggley". Next stop: the Escalator Hall packed with escalators.

dataList.title: Choose an Escalator
dataList.description: We let Пви pick whichever escalator they liked. Now to define the escalator they chose.
